paragraphs.title: Complete Dependence and Waiting for Mercy

answers: To the hand of their masters

answers: To the hand of her mistress

paragraphs.title: A Plea for Mercy Amid Contempt

easy.explanation: They cry, “Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us.”
easy.q: What do the people ask the LORD to do?

easy.explanation: The verse says they are “exceedingly filled with contempt.”
easy.q: With what are the people exceedingly filled?

answers: Those who scorn and show contempt

easy.q: Who are described as being at ease and proud?

answers: They are suffering from scorn and contempt
They want to rule over others
They want to leave the land
